description: Every Avanan email security API call, plus an offline mirror for cross-tenant questions.

novel_features.name: Shift triage
novel_features.description: See everything detected in a window you choose, bucketed by threat type, severity, and state, with the sender domains driving the volume.

novel_features.name: Campaign clustering
novel_features.description: Group detections into candidate phishing campaigns by sender domain and normalized subject, showing recipient spread and how many are still un-remediated.

novel_features.name: Message timeline
novel_features.description: Reconstruct one message's history from what this CLI mirrored and did: detection, the latest mirrored state, actions this CLI submitted, task outcomes, and restore disposition, in order. Actions taken in the Avanan portal or by another tool are not in the mirror and will not appear.

novel_features.name: Exception lookup
novel_features.description: Ask whether a domain, sender, URL, or hash is excepted anywhere across all seven engines and ten exception tables at once.

novel_features.name: Exception audit
novel_features.description: Flag exceptions that contradict each other across sub-systems, exact duplicates, and entries that have not matched traffic in the mirrored window.

novel_features.name: MSP fleet
novel_features.description: One ranked table across every tenant joining licensed seats, add-ons, usage, and detection volume.

novel_features.name: Remediate
novel_features.description: Quarantine or restore a batch, wait for the async task to finish, and report the real per-item outcome.
